AgentActionEvent.description: ActionEvent describes one completed (or rejected) tool call inside a run.

delegate.description:
Delegate is the 1-based delegated question an event belongs to when a
lead runs workers; Question is set on the lead's own event for it.

AgentApproval.description: Approval is a held write as the caller sees it.

preview.description:
Preview is what the write would change, from a dry run that was rolled
back; Preview["available"] is false when the source cannot dry-run.

query.description: Query and Variables are exactly what runs once approved.

decided_by.description: Who or what decided it: the owner, or autonomy:<rule> when a configured rule let it run.

delegated_by.description: Whom a service-identity run acted for.

event_id.description: The watch event that routine ran for.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339; a pending approval reads as expired after it.

hash.description: Binds a decision to this exact write.

origin.description: What proposed it: a chat turn, a watch routine, or a continuation after an earlier decision.

owner_id.description: Who asked; only they can decide it.

preview.description: Rows from a dry run that was rolled back, or {available: false, reason}.

profile.description: The saved agent the run used, if any.

query.description: The exact mutation that runs on approval.

run_id.description: The run that proposed it, if any.

summary.description: What it changes: target, operation and values.

thread_id.description: The thread of the turn that proposed it, if any.

watch_id.description: The watch whose routine proposed it.

reset.description: The text restarted (the model began a new draft); replace what was shown.

AgentDisplayColumn.description: DisplayColumn is a field of the rows, named by its path inside a row.

AgentDisplayHint.description: DisplayHint lays out one result root.

kind.description:
Kind suggests a form: value (one number), bar (one label against one
measure), line (measures over time) or table.

question.description: Question is the delegated question the data answers, on a lead reply.

rows.description:
Rows are the root's rows, at most maxDisplayRows; RowCount is how many
the query returned.

draft.description: Always true: a draft has no oracle yet.

todo.description: What to add before the case joins the corpus.

items.description: An earlier user turn to replay.

correction.description: What the answer should have said, in the person's words.

question.description: The question it answered, from the thread.

AgentFigure.description: Figure is one number in a lead answer and where it came from.

AgentMemoryUsage.description: MemoryUsage names a memory that shaped a turn.

body.description: Detail, such as the change's summary or the routine's answer.

created_at.description: UTC, fixed width: text order is time order.

delegated_by.description: Who delegated the work, when an agent acted for them.

link.description: A console path that opens it.

ref_kind.description: What it is about: approval, thread or task.

seen.description: Whether the owner has seen it.

AgentPreparationStats.description: PreparationStats reports the entire decision stage, including failed calls.

AgentRateLimitConfig.description: RateLimitConfig sets process-local limits for model calls made with the server-owned agent provider.

requests_per_minute.description: Process-local rolling-minute request ceiling; zero disables request limiting
requests_per_minute.title: Agent Provider Requests Per Minute

tokens_per_minute.description: Process-local rolling-minute provider-reported token ceiling; zero disables token limiting
tokens_per_minute.title: Agent Provider Tokens Per Minute

history.description:
History carries prior conversation turns for follow-up resolution. It is
untrusted model context: it reaches the model only as an ax context field
(available to runtime code as inputs.history) and never satisfies a
protocol guard — every run must re-establish its own tool evidence.

task_id.description:
TaskID is an owner-scoped correlation label used by the service to load
declared task context and append a run trail. Like History, it never
satisfies a protocol evidence guard and never grants access.

thread_id.description: Run the turn in this thread (create it with the gj_thread GraphQL root). Its stored history replaces any history in the body, and the turn is stored with its run.

approval.description:
Approval is the held write a needs_approval reply asks the user to
approve or reject.

display.description:
Display describes the data behind an answer so a GUI can lay it out
without guessing: typed columns, the rows, and a suggested form.

figures.description:
Figures names where each figure in a lead's answer came from; a figure
with no source is listed in an unverified_figures notice.

memories.description: Memories names the saved memories that shaped a lead's answer.

AgentSelectionConfig.description: SelectionConfig configures the independent, tool-less Ax decision stage.

owner_ref.description: An opaque reference to the owner.

profile.description: The saved agent (agent_profile id) the thread talks to, if any.

unread.description: An answer arrived after the owner last looked.

AgentUsageTotals.description: UsageTotals is the stable, provider-neutral token accounting exposed by an agent run.

post.description: Runs one agent turn. Without thread_id the call is stateless; with it the turn is stored in that thread and the reply carries thread_id and run_id. With `Accept: text/event-stream` the turn streams as server-sent events: `run` ({thread_id, run_id}, threaded turns only), `action` (AgentActionEvent, one per tool step), `delta` (AgentDeltaEvent, the reply text as it is written; not stored, so a reconnecting client never sees it), `result` (the final AgentResponse, authoritative), `complete` ({status}) and `error` ({error}).

schema.description: With `Accept: text/event-stream` the turn streams as server-sent events: `run` ({thread_id, run_id}, threaded turns only), `action` (AgentActionEvent, one per tool step), `delta` (AgentDeltaEvent, the reply text as it is written; not stored, so a reconnecting client never sees it), `result` (the final AgentResponse, authoritative), `complete` ({status}) and `error` ({error}).

200.description: The agent's reply. Check status: answered, needs_clarification, needs_approval (approval holds the pending write), blocked (refusal says why) or error.

400.description: The body could not be read, or names a thread when threads are off.

get.description: Replays the run's stored events after Last-Event-ID (or ?after=N), then follows new ones until `complete`. Any replica can serve it. Events: `action`, `result`, `complete`, `error`; `delta` is live-only and never replayed.

get.description: Changes waiting for approval, routine answers, stopped runs and task checks. Mark them seen here or through gj_notification(update: { seen }).

Server-sent events: `notification` (AgentNotification) for each one created after the cursor, and `count` ({unseen_count}) whenever the caller's unseen count changes. The event id is the notification's creation time in microseconds; resume with Last-Event-ID or ?after=. Without a cursor the stream starts now; list the backlog with GET /api/v1/notifications.

seen.description: Default true; false marks it unseen.
